detail: Directed fix for run 33464309221: actions/checkout rejects paths outside GITHUB_WORKSPACE. The workflow now checks out pinned Groundtruth at the supported workspace path, relocates it to RUNNER_TEMP before setup/install/pytest, and uses the relocated absolute source path for Go/Python. This keeps the nested source out of failure-ID scanning while retaining immutable producer provenance. Prior RED diagnosis remains packeted; focused emitter/bridge tests and YAML parse pass.
